title: vLLM & Distributed Kernels: Interview Prep
summary: A FAANG interview bootcamp for LLM inference & distributed GPU systems — PagedAttention, continuous batching, and the vLLM scheduler, then collective communication, ring vs tree all-reduce, NCCL topology, and custom fused all-reduce kernels. Conceptual Q&A, spot-the-bug, and system-design rubrics.

title: PyTorch Interview Prep: Amateur to Expert
summary: An 8-week FAANG interview bootcamp for PyTorch — tensors and autograd through torch.compile, FSDP2, and ML system design. Conceptual Q&A, live-coding solutions, spot-the-bug challenges, and design rubrics, all on verified PyTorch 2.x APIs.

title: How vLLM Scales Across GPUs
summary: A WebGL walkthrough of vLLM V1's four parallelism dimensions — tensor, pipeline, Wide EP, and disaggregated serving — with animated all-reduce, pipeline bubbles, expert dispatch, and KV transfer, each grounded in the merged PRs behind it.

title: vLLM Optimization Deep Dive
summary: Master vLLM's optimization internals through Triton kernel implementations.

title: NKI Kernel Programming
summary: Program AWS Trainium from first tile to Flash Attention using NKI — the CUDA of Neuron hardware.

title: The Attention Family: A Visual Guide
summary: A 3Blue1Brown-style WebGL journey through attention and its variants — from Q/K/V and the T×T score matrix to MQA, GQA, MLA, sparse, linear, and FlashAttention, each animated to show how it beats the O(T²) cost.
